about: The replay set of D9 (MAIL.md): invented cases, one for each shape the real mail and Telegram cases of 30 September to 11 October 2026 had (the ten of task 74-03 among them), written so that no real person's mail is in the repository, each with its asks as the reading maps them and the status Rouh's code must give each, from the grants the contact holds. Then the guardrails task 74's guards.py held, as asks. rouh/mail_replay.py runs them through mail_ledger.judge, the very function a run and Test grants use; land.sh refuses to land mail code that changes any outcome here. The quoted words, people, companies and places are all made up. `states` (12 October 2026, MAIL.md D14 to D17): where a case says it is, through `case_state.of` - its words, whether it is running, its next action and which failed asks are possible now - for Sam's itinerary as it rests, and the guards that a waiting case always names its action and that nothing is said to run unless it does. `gate` (12 October 2026, MAIL.md D18): the case is an entry gate only. Sam's itinerary as it arrived before her grants, through the gate: one first message listing what was allowed and started and what needs Alex and waits; one batch of his decisions, one message; a started job that fails, which raises no decision and sends nothing; a job that needs what was not decided, which puts it on the ask it stopped and makes a decision, never a new ask; and two results that finish together, one message. `phantoms` (16 October 2026, MAIL.md D29): Sam's case 51 as it stood that morning, with the ask the work made up: it is folded away, every real ask done and nothing put to Alex; a run that finds the work done already is done, never failed; and a permission she holds is never asked for. `readings` (21 October 2026, MAIL.md D34): case 53 as it was read and re-run three times. The same message read twice gives the same reading, whatever the second reading made of it; "talk to you in the interface" is never a hard limit, at the reading, as a run's need or when the case is judged again, while words that ask for an effect still name one; a covered ask that fails is tried again by itself and is never a decision, until it has failed MAX_TRIES times, when the contact is told; and the reader is given the contact's permissions, inherited ones with the task they come through.
